Independently re-derived normal form r=1/4+(t-1/4)/x-3/(16x^2), Kovacic d-values {t-1,t-1/2,-t-1/2,-t} (never in N for transcendental t, so no rational Riccati solution, case A excluded); Sym^2 indicial (m-1)(2m-1)(2m-3)/4 at 0 and m(m-1)(m-2) off 0 plus degree count at infinity force no nonzero rational Sym^2 solution (case B excluded); infinitude via rank-one irregular point at infinity with distinct exponentials e^{0},e^{x} (exponential torus nontrivial, standard Ramis/van der Put-Singer), so classical group is SL2. Lax nonexistence re-checked entry-by-entry: centralizer(J), ad_K eigenvalues {0,0,1/2,-1/2}, B has no pole and deg<=0, then [B0,K]=E impossible since (1,2)-entry forces b=0 but (2,1)-entry becomes -1. Intermediate sign conventions in DRAFT sections 5(i)-(ii) are misstated (k*Id+ad_K vs -k*Id-ad_K) but both signs give nonzero eigenvalues/gap +-beta*d/2, so the vanishing conclusion stands as machine-checked. Special-fiber census for all n in Z is only rank-evidenced for degrees 0-3 plus explicit witnesses at t=0,-1/2,1/2,1,-1; the generic-t headline does not depend on closing that census. Proof vs computation vs corroboration are separated in DRAFT section 7.

Adversarial equivalent/broader/database/implication checks all documented in decisive_checks.

value.rationale: TARGET route with no preset fallback; audited normally. The headline is a rigorously established exact invariant (PPV group = full SL2, det=1 only, non-isomonodromic; classical group SL2; no rational Riccati, Sym^2, or Lax solutions for generic t) of a specific natural object motivated before computation: the Kummer confluent-hypergeometric operator with fixed exponent c=1/2 and Kummer parameter t transcendental, with regular singularity at 0 and rank-one irregular singularity at infinity. The value (which of Borel/dihedral/finite/full occurs, and the explicit dt-equations: none beyond det=1) was not known or mechanically implied, resolves the admitted trichotomy, and is precisely the fact a future researcher on parameterized confluent equations, isomonodromy, or Kovacic testing would need to retrieve. It is not a textbook restatement, mere parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; the integer/half-integer Liouvillian fibers give the boundary. Incomplete special-fiber census is honestly limited and does not erase the headline per STANDARD exact-invariant clause.
